answers.core: As the ecosystem third-party of `EditorPlugin`s grows, we will want to allow them to act like normal Godot functionality, and so we should provide some "official" way to accomplish this
answers.workaround:
This can sort of be worked around via script - this code works:

```
var editor_debugger_node = get_tree().root.find_children("*", "EditorDebuggerNode", true, false)[0]
```

... to get the `EditorDebuggerNode` and than manually call its methods

But if we do want folks to do this manually in their `EditorPlugin`s, that's pretty nasty, and we should expose it more directly (maybe on `EditorInterface`?). If we don't want folks to do it that way, and have it happen more automatically, then we definitely need to change Godot

title: Allow `EditorPlugin`s that update the current scene to also live update the running game
